tool_signatures.name: depguard_audit
tool_signatures.description: Deep security audit of a single npm package. Downloads the tarball, scans source code for malware, checks vulnerabilities (npm + GitHub Advisory), analyzes install scripts, verifies license. Use when you need full details on a specific package. Pass a version to audit a specific installed version instead of latest.

tool_signatures.name: depguard_audit_bulk
tool_signatures.description: Audit multiple packages in one call. Accepts an array of names or a dependencies object from package.json. Use depguard_audit_project instead if you have a package.json path.

tool_signatures.name: depguard_audit_deep
tool_signatures.description: Audit the full transitive dependency tree of a package. Crawls all nested dependencies recursively and aggregates vulnerabilities across the entire graph. Use when you need to know the total attack surface, not just direct deps.

tool_signatures.name: depguard_audit_project
tool_signatures.description: Audit ALL dependencies in a project at once. Scans direct deps (full audit), transitive deps from lock file (vulnerability check), and the packageManager field. Pass the path to package.json and get a consolidated security report. Use this when the user asks to review project security or after cloning a new repo.

tool_signatures.name: depguard_audit_workspace
tool_signatures.description: MANDATORY: call this AFTER cloning a repository and BEFORE opening it in any IDE (VS Code, Cursor, JetBrains, etc.) or running

tool_signatures.name: depguard_guard
tool_signatures.description: MANDATORY: call this BEFORE running npm install, yarn add, or pnpm add — whether the user asked for the package or you decided to install it yourself. Verifies the package exists (blocks hallucinated names), checks for typosquatting, runs security audit, and returns allow/warn/block. If the result is

tool_signatures.name: depguard_remediate
tool_signatures.description: Build a remediation plan for a project with known vulnerabilities. Reads package.json + lock file, runs the same audit as depguard_audit_project, then groups every vulnerable transitive under the direct dep that pulls it in. Output is sorted by severity weight so the first remediation is the highest-impact bump. Use this when the user is staring at

tool_signatures.name: depguard_review
tool_signatures.description: Call this AFTER making significant code changes or before the user commits. Scans source files for issues you may have introduced: console.logs left in production code, empty catch blocks, broken imports, TODOs without issue references, empty test files, orphan files. Fix the findings before reporting your work as done.

tool_signatures.name: depguard_sbom
tool_signatures.description: Generate a CycloneDX 1.6 Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) for an npm project. Reads package.json + lock file to enumerate direct + transitive components with PURLs and integrity hashes. Set includeVex=true to embed vulnerability data (VEX) from the audit pipeline. Use this when the user asks for an SBOM, a compliance report, or to comply with EU CRA / US EO 14028 requirements.

tool_signatures.name: depguard_score
tool_signatures.description: Quick 0-100 quality score for a package. Faster than depguard_audit when you only need the score. Critical vulns cap at 30, high at 50.

tool_signatures.name: depguard_search
tool_signatures.description: Search npm for packages by keywords, sorted by depguard quality score. Use when you need to find packages but already know the keywords.

tool_signatures.name: depguard_sweep
tool_signatures.description: Find unused npm packages in the project. Scans source files for imports and cross-references with package.json. Also detects phantom deps (installed but not declared). Call this after a coding session where you installed multiple packages — some may no longer be needed.

tool_signatures.name: depguard_verify
tool_signatures.description: Quick check if a package name exists on npm + typosquatting detection. Faster than depguard_guard when you only need existence verification without a full audit.
